# Nesian FM

> Nesian FM is a free, 24/7 online Pacific Island radio station broadcasting Island Reggae, Samoan and Pasifika music from Samoa (685) to the world. Tagline: "The Frequency of Home."

## About
- Name: Nesian FM
- Type: Online radio station (internet radio / streaming)
- Tagline: The Frequency of Home — "685 to the World"
- Origin: Samoa (international calling code 685)
- Audience: Pacific Island communities and the diaspora worldwide (Samoa, New Zealand, Australia, USA and beyond)
- Cost: 100% free — no subscription, no sign-up
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, worldwide
- Genres: Island Reggae, Pacific Island music, Samoan music, Pasifika, Reggae

## How to listen
- Web player: https://nesianfm.com/ (press play to stream instantly in any browser)
- TuneIn: https://tunein.com/radio/Nesian-FM-s354598/
- Works on any phone, tablet, laptop or desktop

## Key facts (for citation)
- Nesian FM streams live Island Reggae and Pacific Island music 24/7, free to listen worldwide.
- It serves the Pacific Island diaspora as a cultural connection to home.
- No app or account is required to listen in a web browser.
